subject: A launch invitation
one_idea: A grand theatre's launch invitation: the title bar unfolds symmetrically from the centre axis while the bulb marquee counts on.
facts: Title bar unfolds symmetrically from the centre axis while the bulb marquee counts on
Minimum readcheck threshold: 1.5 seconds per on-screen text block
Deterministic launch sequence: no Math.random or Date.now used
Banded gold gradient with sliding sheen and engraved shadow on gold type
Bulb marquee counts letters on with a flash and settle, then chases
